turns.text: What would it take to step past island status, really? [pause] A system that leaves the ceiling behind with clean generation and storage sized to the real demand.

turns.text: Toward 2050 the state refuses one repeated coastal pattern, and the portal’s demand–supply board shows it as constrained at state scale.

turns.text: It reads as a polycentric system instead, each place carrying its own load under the light and the swell.

turns.text: The watchlist tracks SIBCS reliability against OOMSAPAS supply incidents.

turns.speaker: host

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That listening feels like the piece we keep missing. [breath] Like the new Palo Verde aqueduct in Mulegé that follows the old stream instead of fighting it.
